title: I built a VHS store where your taste has witnesses.
author: Otownkid81
selftext:
In Last Call at Video Club, you run Night Owl Video Club in Bellweather, 1998. The regulars remember your recommendations. After closing, you follow the After Hours mystery.



I built it by talking with Savi, Spawn's AI companion. I chose the setting and kept pushing for customers with their own stories. Getting Maya Torres to actually ring them up took several rounds. Her first successful checkout was Dolores, the church organist hiding her horror rentals.



That was the part I cared about: a counter with people on the other side, rather than interchangeable customers.



151 hours and 78 messages got me to Alpha 0.1. It is published for playtesting, with bugs and changes expected.



free, play it in your browser: [https://www.spawn.co/@mohausen/last-call-at-video-club](https://www.spawn.co/@mohausen/last-call-at-video-club)
